art_instructions: Show the cozy attic bedroom with exposed wooden beams, creamy white walls, and a small rounded window on the left letting in a faint cool-blue dusk glow, while warm amber lamplight fills the room. Place a small wooden bed against the back wall under the sloped ceiling; the forest-green blanket is half-pulled back. The owl, a small mottled brown-and-cream bird with round amber eyes, is sitting upright in the bed waking up: one wing stretches upward and slightly outward, the other wing rubs her eye, and her beak opens in a tiny yawn with a sleepy-but-brightening expression. Her green scarf is not yet on; drape it over the headboard’s corner, and hang her tiny satchel on a wall peg to the right of the bed. On a nightstand to the right of the bed, show a softly glowing acorn lantern and a small stack of picture books. Along the left wall, include a low shelf with a few stuffed animals and trinkets, and place a soft rug on the wooden floor near the bed. Keep colors warm and gentle: amber light (#FFD580) on rich brown wood (#8B4513), forest-green bedding (#6B8E23), and cream walls (#F5F5DC). Compose the scene so the bed and owl occupy the center-right of the image, with the window and shelf clearly visible to the left; no other characters appear.
